div.head: ECf retr Rb Inscr
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 670 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

This is one of the chapter headings (rubrics) that a later writer, whom Liebermann calls “Rubricator II” and dates 1163–1189, made for the Retractator’s text; so the date given for ECf retr (c. 1140–59) does not apply to it. Liebermann prints them on pp. 670–672 as an appendix (Anhang) to ECf retr; they are numbered here “Rb” with his Roman numerals. He prints in small type what is taken from the text of ECf retr, so the words in bold are the Rubricator’s own.
Liebermann’s note a is on the heading of the whole appendix, “[Anhanga: Rubricator II. zu Edwardus Confessor retractatus.] [1163—1189]”; it is given here.

after Wl art., above p. 488, note 60, from Lb f. 195, Hv (which puts each rubric in the text before its chapter), Ra Vi Gr (where the numbers are lacking), Rc La Ph Lond (i.e. K Co Or); cf. above p. 627, note a, col. 2, note 7; I print in small type what comes from the text of ECf retr. — Rubricator II writes after Edward’s canonisation and before the death of Henry II.
